method_notes: Weighted knockout results most heavily, then group-stage defensive records as a fatigue-resistant signal five matches in, with historical knockout pedigree as a tiebreaker. Penalised teams whose wins have come with high goals-against totals.

predictions.reasoning: France have the best attack-defence balance in the tournament (13-2 across five games) and beat Morocco at this stage in 2022, though Morocco's Canada demolition keeps this from being higher confidence.
Spain are yet to concede in five matches while Belgium have shipped four goals in two knockout wins, and that defensive gap decides tight quarter-finals.
Norway's Brazil upset was real but they have conceded in every match bar one, and England's steadier defence plus deeper squad should outlast the Haaland threat.

Argentina's attack is functioning (six goals in two knockout games) while Switzerland needed penalties after failing to score against Colombia, though Argentina's leaky recent defence keeps Swiss upset chances alive.
